{{Quote|You trained for weeks to challenge me. You failed. Victory is mine again.|Fohargh taunts Bane|<ref name="DB" />}}
The '''Makurth''' were [[Reptile/Legends|saurians]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Moltok/Legends|Moltok]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Forest/Legends|rainforests]] and [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]] in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. They often found work as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] in the criminal underworld. During the [[New Sith Wars]], a notable Makurth was [[Fohargh]], a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Sith training|trained]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Makurth were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Limb/Legends|bipedal]] [[Reptile/Legends|saurians]], covered in [[Color/Legends|green]] scales. Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] typically possessed four horns on their heads; two curled downwards from the top of their [[Bone/Legends|skull]], while two curled upward from the sides of the cranium. They were nocturnal [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]] who bore savage-looking [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. Makurth could produce a terrifying scream, which they uttered before entering combat, and they were prone to snorting and flaring their nostrils in order to intimidate opponents.<ref name="CCG" /><ref name="DB" />

==History==
{{Quote|I heard accounts of what you did to that Makurth. That showed what you were capable of.|[[Githany]], to Bane|<ref name="DB" />}}
[[File:Planet14-SWR.png|thumb|left|220px|The Outer Rim planet Moltok was the homeworld of the Makurth species.]]
[[Homeworld/Legends|Native]] to [[Moltok/Legends|Moltok]],<ref name="CCG" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Forest/Legends|rainforests]] and [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]]<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Dartibek system|Moltok system]]</ref> the Makurth shared their homeworld with the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]], another reptilian species,<ref name="GG4" /> who traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from at least [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref> The Makurth themselves were offworld by [[1001 BBY]], when one of their number, [[Fohargh]], [[Sith training|trained]] as a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Only the strongest apprentices, those with the potential to become [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] in the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], were trained there. While at the [[Sith academy|Academy]], Fohargh [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] the [[Human/Legends|Human]] apprentice [[Darth Bane/Legends|Bane]] twice. In the first of these encounters, although Fohargh was at a height and weight disadvantage, he had badly beaten the Human, who had mistakenly assumed the nocturnal Makurth would be sluggish during the [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. The second encounter was a more evenly matched fight, until the Makurth managed to disarm Bane. Taunting his opponent, he appeared to have the match won, until Bane used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|strangle]] the life out of the saurian.<ref name="DB" /> In later [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], Makurth were frequently found as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] in the criminal syndicate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="CCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Makurth species' origins date back to the production stages of the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], as one of several [[Alien/Legends|alien]] maquettes constructed for intended use in the film's [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] scenes. Among the maquettes scrapped before the film's production was "Alien 19," a design with a four-horned head.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> In [[1998]], the Makurth were created by [[Decipher]] using a modified image of "Alien 19" on a card for their ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' expansion pack to the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], thus bringing the maquette into the ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' [[canon]]. The card provided a short blurb for the species, placing them on Moltok,<ref name="CCG" /> a planet previously detailed by [[West End Games]], with a pre-existing sentient species, the Ho'Din.<ref name="GG4" /> In [[2006]], the first Makurth individual was created by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] for his novel ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''.<ref name="DB" />
